PowerShell($c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($c\) { taskkill /PID $c.OwningProcess /F } else { "port 3000 deja libre" }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; if \(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\) { "ENCORE OCCUPE" } else { "port 3000 libre" })

PowerShell(Get-ChildItem -Path .next -Directory -Force | ForEach-Object { $m = Get-ChildItem $_.FullName -Recurse -File -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum; [PSCustomObject]@{Dir=$_.Name; Files=$m.Count; MB=[math]::Round\($m.Sum/1MB\)} } | Sort-Object MB -Descending | Format-Table -AutoSize)

PowerShell(Get-ChildItem .next\\dev -Force | Select-Object Mode,Name,Length | Format-Table -AutoSize; "--- sous-dossiers ---"; Get-ChildItem .next\\dev -Directory -Force | ForEach-Object { $m = Get-ChildItem $_.FullName -Recurse -File -Force -EA SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object Length -Sum; [PSCustomObject]@{Dir=$_.Name; Files=$m.Count; MB=[math]::Round\($m.Sum/1MB\)} } | Sort-Object MB -Descending | Select-Object -First 15 | Format-Table -AutoSize)

PowerShell(Get-ChildItem .next\\dev\\cache -Directory -Force | ForEach-Object { $m = Get-ChildItem $_.FullName -Recurse -File -Force -EA SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object Length -Sum; [PSCustomObject]@{Dir=$_.Name; Files=$m.Count; MB=[math]::Round\($m.Sum/1MB\)} } | Sort-Object MB -Descending | Select-Object -First 15 | Format-Table -AutoSize; "--- fichiers racine cache ---"; Get-ChildItem .next\\dev\\cache -File -Force | Select-Object -First 10 Name,Length | Format-Table -AutoSize)
